'''DecipherCon 1999 Players Choice''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). [[Rick Gaudioso]] won, out of 31 players over 3 games.<ref name="dc99sw21_3">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW21_3.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Players Choice], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001219114400/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW21_3.html Internet Archive]</ref>
